_doc: Monster behaviour, first wave (AI-1, 2026-11-19): the numbers and lines of each behaviour, one section each. The per-kind fields (light_shy, alarm, death_throes, relurks, hides_in_dark, drain_share, drain_con, morale, morale_style, heal_cooldown, heal_below, summon_live_cap; on an attack recharge, drains_life, snuffs_light, snuff_chance, shove) are in data/monsters.json and read through src/kind_data.py. Lines are filled by monster.fill: {The} {the} {A} {a} and the pronoun slots {he} {He} {him} {his} {His} {himself}. A line with 'unseen' in its key is said when the hero cannot see the creature: it never names it. docs/systems/monsters.md, 'Monster behaviour, first wave', says what each one does.

healer._doc: src/faction.py: a healer mends only its own side (war-band, else pack, else family, else kind), only a friend under heal_below of its health, the one fighting the hero first, then the most hurt; then it rests its voice heal_cooldown turns.

summoner._doc: src/summoning.py: the timer runs only while it hunts the hero; it calls only with the hero within reach and in sight and fewer than live_cap of its summoned standing; the call is a one-turn chant that a landed blow breaks.
summoner.chant_line: {The} raises {his} hands and begins to chant.
summoner.chant_unseen: Somewhere near, a voice begins a low chant.

breath._doc: src/breath.py: a delivery 'breath' attack of an ordinary kind needs 3 turns before it can come again (an attack's own `recharge` wins); named foes only when their data says. ready_lines by the breath's damage type, said when it is ready again and the hero can see it.

ready_lines.acid: Something hisses and drips from {the}'s jaws.
ready_lines.poison: A green haze seeps from {the}'s jaws.
ready_lines.necrotic: A grave-cold mist gathers in {the}'s throat.
